traits.accuracy: Speech / non-speech discrimination under background noise (fewer false endpoints and false barge-ins).
traits.latency: Delay between audio arriving and the speech decision (subprocess bridges decide one chunk late by design).
traits.footprint: CPU, memory and setup cost: no subprocess, no model file, no extra Python package.

evidence: libs/core/voice-activity-detector.ts (EnergyVad: RMS threshold per 16-bit PCM frame, 'replace before high-noise environments')
libs/core/silero-vad-bridge.ts (neural VAD over an onnxruntime Python subprocess; one chunk late; needs KYBERION_SILERO_VAD_MODEL)
libs/core/ten-vad-bridge.ts (upstream TEN VAD Python binding over NDJSON; one chunk late; needs the ten_vad package)
Upstream TEN VAD README claims lower latency than Silero at comparable precision (not measured locally)

accuracy.description: Noisy rooms, meetings and barge-in, where false endpoints or false interruptions cost more than a little latency.

light.description: Quiet single-speaker use or constrained machines: the cheapest detector that responds immediately.
